<subject>Re: AgroTrade Regarding Fresh Harvest</subject>
<body>
Reyansh Salvi

From what I gather, Hebert lacks the legal mandate (and the filing is unclear) to pause deliveries under the Commodity Supply Agreement (CSA) (he likely also lacks the internal backing for this step).

However, AgriIndia could endorse this in its submission as a strategy to progress the Farmer Supplier (FS) issue.

Hardik





	Reyansh Krish
	Sent by: Reyansh Krish
	20/03/2024 10:04 AM
		 
		 To: Dakshesh Basak, Libni Kibe, Charita 
Balay, Amruta Wali, Manya 
Bal, Hardik Pal, Christopher 
Baral, Matthew Nazareth, Vrinda Mangat
		 cc: 
		 Subject: AgroTrade Regarding Fresh Harvest

FYI. Any views Dakshesh & team? Could contract release be considered an "increase supply" approach? My concern is that if FS are released, then Maharashtra’s strict regulatory stance will activate, imposing controls and policies to ensure crop outputs remain within the state.

Best,
Reyansh
</body>
